title: AN ACT relating to teacher scholarships, making an appropriation therefor, and declaring an emergency.
subject: Appropriations
Education, Elementary And Secondary
Education, Finance

Effective Dates, Emergency
Teachers

abstracts.abstract: Amend KRS 164.769 to establish a pilot program to provide scholarships to students pursuing a teaching career in a math- or science-related discipline to be administered by the Kentucky Higher Education Assistance Authority; establish scholarship recipient selection, award, and repayment process; appropriate $4,175,000 in each fiscal year of the 2026-2028 fiscal biennium to support the program; APPROPRIATION; EMERGENCY.
